name: Makan Art Space
watch: Artist-run; unclear whether it still operates.

name: Tikhaya Studio
watch: Nine resident artists; collaborates with Garage on an archive of the Nizhny Novgorod scene.

name: Alice Yard
watch: Artist-run space in Belmont, Port of Spain, 20 years old in 2026. Trinbagonians for Palestine supported a 2025 film event.

name: Livingstone Office for Contemporary Arts (LoCA)
watch: Launched the Mosi-oa-Tunya Perennial in Sept 2026; funder roster not public.

name: Image Factory Art Foundation (Imagination Factory)
watch: Renamed Imagination Factory in 2025. Its website is a web host's placeholder. Founder Yasser Musa is Said Musa's son.

name: Bandjoun Station
watch: Residencies and a museum, plus a farm, in the Bamileke highlands; MO.CO Montpellier sends graduates for residencies (since 2023).

name: Le Cube – independent art room
watch: Independent exhibition and residency space at 2 rue Benzerte, with a Vienna branch; it still has a programme in 2026.

name: Urban Shaman Contemporary Aboriginal Art
watch: Indigenous artist-run centre founded in 1996 in the Exchange District.
